title: looking for testers for my demo
author: Present_Reality_2197
selftext:
i have a demo of my game up at https://thetk421guy.itch.io/broken-dagger

working title is 

Broken Dagger: Whistle of the Wayfarer 

this is like an rpg action adventure beat em up i guess. it is heavily inspired by HLD and Majoras mask to the point where i will probably be looking for help with artwork in the near future (the character sprite is an edited drifter sprite) i was aiming for the feel of that game and it was the best placeholder at the time. my main goal is just making a playable game. for now this is what i have that is functioning. i posted this game about 6 months ago and got some advice that helped a bunch so im trying again. this demo is just one test room with a few simple waves of easy enemies.
